calibration.decision: CALIBRATION NOT SUFFICIENT — RETAIN RANKING SCORE ONLY

policy.acceptance: calibrated Brier, ECE, and log loss no worse than raw, with ECE <= 0.10

calibration.ranking_note: Platt is monotonic; any exact-order difference is a deterministic tie change from floating-point compression of nearly equal raw scores.

limitations: Synthetic/curated dataset, not real-world accuracy evidence.
Only 5 held-out migration groups; intervals are group-bootstrap uncertainty, not precise population guarantees.
Mutation families and API families are imbalanced.
VALIDATION was reused for M8 model selection and M9 calibration; TEST remained independently held out.
